objects.name: The Toll-Light
objects.vInscr: The toll here was paid in teeth. The box is full.

landmarks.name: The Unfaced Saint
landmarks.inscription: Its own order took the face away, lest the pilgrims learn to whom they had been praying.

landmarks.name: The Mourner Before
landmarks.inscription: It began to weep the night before the dying. The moor-folk bring it candles, so it need not weep in the dark.

landmarks.name: The Unmirroring Ring
landmarks.inscription: Seven stones for Ysse, who could not bear her own face. The water keeps her wish: lean over it, and it shows you only the dark.

landmarks.name: The Bound Oathwright
landmarks.inscription: They tied their god to the tree so it could not leave them. It did not leave. It did not answer either.
